Homework week 4

Amjad and Ahmed · free time and chores · How often? · one day at a time

🎙️ لا تنسَ: أرسل على واتساب قبل حصة الاثنين: رسالة صوتية عن أسبوعك، و٣ جمل عن أخيك، والكتابة. اليوم ٤

Don't forget: before Monday's class, send on WhatsApp your "My week" voice note, 3 sentences about your brother, and your writing.

Day 1 · Listening · الاستماع

اضغط ▶ واستمع بدون قراءة. ثم أجب واضغط «تحقق». استمع مرة ثالثة مع النص.

Press ▶ and listen without reading. Answer, then press Check. Listen a third time with the text.

Recording 1 · Amjad's week · أسبوع أمجد

Amjad sends a voice message to Karim, a new colleague. He talks about his week.

How often does Amjad…? · كم مرة؟

Amjad …How often?
check the stock
have a meeting with Ahmed
visit the second warehouse
go to the gym
make dinner
do the shopping
visit his mother
work on Friday
  1. AmjadHi, Karim. You asked about my week, so here it is.Your turn · دورك
  2. AmjadI always get up at six o'clock, and I usually have breakfast with my family.Your turn · دورك
  3. AmjadI work from Saturday to Thursday. I never work on Friday.Your turn · دورك
  4. AmjadAt work, I check the stock every day, and I have a meeting with Ahmed twice a week, on Sunday and Wednesday.Your turn · دورك
  5. AmjadI visit the second warehouse once a week, usually on Tuesday.Your turn · دورك
  6. AmjadAfter work, I sometimes go to the gym. I go about twice a week.Your turn · دورك
  7. AmjadI'm not a good cook, so I never make dinner. My wife cooks, and I wash the dishes.Your turn · دورك
  8. AmjadI do the shopping once a week, on Thursday evening.Your turn · دورك
  9. AmjadOn Friday morning, I usually clean the car.Your turn · دورك
  10. AmjadThen I visit my mother. I visit her every Friday.Your turn · دورك
  11. AmjadIn the afternoon, I sometimes take a nap.Your turn · دورك
  12. AmjadIn the evening, I often watch football with Ahmed.Your turn · دورك
  13. AmjadI watch TV every evening, but only for one hour.Your turn · دورك
  14. AmjadI usually go to bed at eleven. That's my week. See you on Sunday!Your turn · دورك

Recording 2 · Ahmed and the new worker · أحمد والعامل الجديد

Omar is a new worker. He asks Ahmed about the work and about free time.

Questions · الأسئلة

  1. What time do they start on Thursday?

  2. How often do they clean the loading area?

  3. How many times a day do the trucks come?

  4. How often does Ahmed play football?

  5. What does Omar do on the weekend?

  6. Why does Omar never go out on Thursday night?

  1. OmarExcuse me, Ahmed. Can I ask you some questions about the work here?Your turn · دورك
  2. AhmedOf course, Omar. What do you want to know?Your turn · دورك
  3. OmarWhat time do we start in the morning?Your turn · دورك
  4. AhmedWe usually start at seven. On Thursday, we start at eight.Your turn · دورك
  5. OmarHow often do we clean the loading area?Your turn · دورك
  6. AhmedWe clean it every day, at the end of the shift.Your turn · دورك
  7. OmarAnd how often do the trucks come?Your turn · دورك
  8. AhmedThree times a day. In the morning, at noon and in the afternoon.Your turn · دورك
  9. OmarOK. What do you usually do after work?Your turn · دورك
  10. AhmedI usually go home and have dinner with my family. Sometimes I play football with my friends.Your turn · دورك
  11. OmarHow often do you play?Your turn · دورك
  12. AhmedOnce a week, on Tuesday evening. Do you like football?Your turn · دورك
  13. OmarYes, but I don't play. I always watch it on TV.Your turn · دورك
  14. AhmedAnd what do you do on the weekend?Your turn · دورك
  15. OmarI do the laundry and I clean my apartment. I never go out on Thursday night.Your turn · دورك
  16. AhmedWhy not?Your turn · دورك
  17. OmarBecause I'm always tired!Your turn · دورك
  18. AhmedDon't worry. The work is easier after the first month.Your turn · دورك

Day 2 · Listen and repeat · استمع وكرّر

اضغط ▶ على الجملة واستمع، ثم كرّرها بصوت عالٍ بالسرعة نفسها. كرّر كل جملة ٣ مرات. انتبه إلى s في: gets, goes, does, watches.

Press ▶, listen, then say it out loud at the same speed. Repeat each sentence 3 times. Listen for the -s: gets, goes, does, watches.

  1. 1I always get up at six o'clock.
  2. 2I usually have breakfast with my family.
  3. 3I never work on Friday.
  4. 4We check the stock every day.
  5. 5I have a meeting with Amjad twice a week.
  6. 6How often do you go to the gym?
  7. 7I go to the gym three times a week.
  8. 8He gets up at five thirty and goes to work at six.
  9. 9She does the laundry once a week.
  10. 10I sometimes take a nap on Friday afternoon.
  11. 11We clean the loading area at the end of the shift.
  12. 12My brother often watches football on TV.
  13. 13I do the shopping on Thursday evening.
  14. 14I take out the garbage every day.
  15. 15Do you usually wash the dishes?
  16. 16He never makes dinner, but he washes the dishes.
  17. 17The trucks come three times a day.
  18. 18What do you do in your free time?
  19. 19In my free time, I play football with my friends.
  20. 20I usually go to bed at eleven o'clock.

٣. مثّل الدورين.

Day 4 · Speaking and writing · المحادثة والكتابة

1 · Voice note: my week · رسالة صوتية: أسبوعي

سجّل رسالة صوتية مدتها دقيقة واحدة عن أسبوعك. استخدم الجمل في الإطار. أرسلها إلى المعلم على واتساب.

Record a 1-minute WhatsApp voice note about your week. Use these sentence starters.

  1. I always …
  2. I usually …
  3. I often …
  4. I sometimes …
  5. I never …
  6. Once a week, I …
  7. Twice a week, I …

2 · "How often?" survey · استبيان «كم مرة؟»

اسأل أخاك هذه الأسئلة واكتب أجوبته. ثم أرسل رسالة صوتية فيها ٣ جمل عنه، مثلاً: My brother never takes a nap.

Ask your brother these questions and write his answers. Then send a voice note with 3 sentences about him: “My brother never takes a nap.”

How often do you go to the gym?
How often do you clean the car?
How often do you do the shopping?
How often do you visit your family?
How often do you watch football?
How often do you take a nap?
How often do you cook dinner?
How often do you wash the dishes?

3 · Writing: my weekend chores · الكتابة: أعمال البيت في عطلتي

اكتب ٥ جمل عن أعمال البيت في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع. ثم اضغط «انسخ» وألصقها في واتساب وأرسلها إلى المعلم.

Write 5 sentences about your weekend chores. Press Copy, then paste it in WhatsApp and send it to your teacher.

Example: On Friday, I usually clean the car. I sometimes do the shopping with my wife.

All recordings are also in Google Drive to play in the car.
